text: ChatGPT Desktop forwards your SSH agent to remote machines | Hacker News Hacker News new | past | comments | ask | show | jobs | submit login ChatGPT Desktop forwards your SSH agent to remote machines 4 points by DenGorbachev 1 hour ago | hide | past | favorite | 1 comment The agent running on a remote machine can authenticate using your local SSH credentials. That means it can push to your private repos on GitHub, for example. Proof: https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/28131#discussion_r3410013180 littlecranky67 4 minutes ago [–] I'd suggest to use ssh keys inside the secure enclave on macOS that require your fingerprint for every new session [0]. That way agents cannot initiate anything, and you will always be aware when a new ssh connection is being made.
